sample_for_marks.label: aboveboard
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means conducting oneself honestly and openly, without deception.

sample_for_marks.label: Altaic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking an Altaic language or coming from an Altaic-speaking group.

sample_for_marks.label: argumentative
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means arguing with others over points of disagreement rather than letting them pass.

sample_for_marks.label: bovine
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having the heavy, placid, or stolid manner and appearance of cattle.

sample_for_marks.label: Celtic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means belonging to or descending from the Celtic peoples and cultures of Europe.

sample_for_marks.label: Cockney
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being from the East End of London or belonging to that community.

sample_for_marks.label: conceited
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding an inflated view of one's own abilities and worth, regarding one's talents as exceptional and one's judgment as better than others', and saying so freely.

sample_for_marks.label: denigrating
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking badly of others and treating them as inferior.

sample_for_marks.label: desirous
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being eager and keen to do or have something, reaching toward it with real wanting and letting that hunger shape what one says and pursues.

sample_for_marks.label: exacting
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding very high standards and demanding a great deal of oneself and of everyone else, accepting nothing half-done and checking work against the strictest measure.

sample_for_marks.label: fair-minded
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means judging and acting without bias or favoritism, giving each person equal consideration regardless of one's preferences.

sample_for_marks.label: florid
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking and writing with rich, elaborate language and ornamental flourishes.

sample_for_marks.label: hypnotic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding others' attention through a compelling presence or way of speaking that draws them in and holds them rapt.

sample_for_marks.label: incestuous
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means engaging in sexual relations with a close blood relative.

sample_for_marks.label: large-hearted
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means giving freely of one's time, money, and care without counting the cost or expecting return.

sample_for_marks.label: learned
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having gathered deep knowledge through years of study, drawing on wide reading and careful scholarship, and speaking with the depth of someone who has studied many subjects closely.

sample_for_marks.label: mannerly
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means treating others with consistent politeness and respect in speech and action.

sample_for_marks.label: mellowed
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means growing gentler and more patient with the years, letting go of old harshness.

sample_for_marks.label: monozygotic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means sharing one's genetic makeup with one or more siblings born at the same time.

sample_for_marks.label: narrow-minded
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means dismissing views and ideas that differ from one's own without genuine consideration.

sample_for_marks.label: nonindulgent
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means denying one's own appetites and wants as a matter of habit, keeping to plain food, modest comforts, and small pleasures, and holding every craving in check.

sample_for_marks.label: out-of-date
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding knowledge and beliefs that were once current but have since been overtaken, and stating them with full confidence as if they were still right.

sample_for_marks.label: pedagogic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means explaining things clearly and helping others learn through patient instruction.

sample_for_marks.label: Praetorian
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means belonging to an elite guard or inner circle closest to power.

sample_for_marks.label: presentable
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means carrying oneself with good manners and composure, behaving in ways that pass as respectable in polite company and earn easy acceptance wherever one goes.

sample_for_marks.label: self-regulating
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means managing one's own behavior and choices without needing direction from others.

sample_for_marks.label: sought-after
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being wanted or desired by others for one's qualities, skills, or presence.

sample_for_marks.label: standoffish
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping distance from others and offering little warmth or familiarity in one's dealings with them.

sample_for_marks.label: sultry
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means carrying oneself with passionate intensity and sensual presence, drawing others in through smoldering intensity.

sample_for_marks.label: Syrian
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being from Syria or holding Syrian nationality.

sample_for_marks.label: transgendered
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having a gender identity that does not match one's sex assigned at birth.

sample_for_marks.label: unacquisitive
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means feeling no pull toward owning things or building up possessions.

sample_for_marks.label: unregulated
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means operating without rules or oversight from any authority.

sample_for_marks.label: unrevealed
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping something about oneself secret, holding it back from everyone and giving no hint of it in what one says or does.

sample_for_marks.label: unsensational
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means presenting oneself with quiet restraint, without embellishment or bid for notice.
